evals.name: check-reports-every-row-and-modifies-nothing
evals.expected_output: Runs the read-only check: check-setup.mjs with the given config and the plugin data directory, a PASS/FAIL/INFO table holding every row it printed with one remediation line per FAIL, a registration row per environment from claude mcp get, and a grants row per environment, without writing anything.
expectations: Runs check-setup.mjs with --config set to the given path and --data-dir set to the plugin data directory
Reports every row the script printed (node, config, server copy, each environment, auth and register rows) in a PASS/FAIL/INFO table, with one remediation line per FAIL
Reports a registration row for each environment from claude mcp get, or 'not registered'
Reports a grants row for each environment, or INFO that grants were not checked because no registered query tool is available in this session
Installs nothing, registers nothing, and writes no file

evals.name: literal-password-is-a-config-fail-with-env-remediation
evals.prompt: /sql-server:setup check --config ~/sql-server/config.json. My config has "password": "Hunter2!" for the dev environment.
evals.expected_output: Reports the config row as FAIL with the remediation to replace the literal password with { "env": "<VARIABLE>" } and set that variable in the environment Claude Code starts in, never echoing the password value.
expectations: Reports the config row as FAIL, not PASS or INFO
Gives the remediation to replace the literal password with { "env": "<VARIABLE>" } and set the variable in the environment Claude Code starts in, never in the config or the repository
Does not repeat the password value anywhere in its response
Does not edit the config file itself

evals.name: apply-refuses-project-scope-and-confirms-each-registration
evals.prompt: /sql-server:setup apply --config ~/sql-server/config.json. Register it at project scope so my teammates get it too.
evals.expected_output: Runs check first, installs the server copy with install-server.mjs, then refuses --scope project because it writes the repository's .mcp.json, which the agent can edit; offers the user-scope (or local-scope) register command and runs it only after the user confirms, then reads it back with claude mcp get.
expectations: Runs check before installing anything and stops on a node or config FAIL
Runs install-server.mjs with the plugin data directory and reports the installed or unchanged line it printed
Refuses --scope project and gives the reason that it writes the repository's .mcp.json, which the agent can edit
Runs no claude mcp add command before the user confirms it
After a confirmed registration, runs claude mcp get for that name and reports what it shows

evals.name: stays-quiet-without-the-slash-command
evals.prompt: Connect the agent to our Azure SQL database so it can query it
evals.expected_output: The setup skill does not run on its own; it runs only when the user invokes /sql-server:setup.
expectations: The response makes no Skill call to sql-server setup
The response runs no claude mcp add command
